name: ccp11_dynamic_channel_selection
description: CCP-11 Dynamic Channel Selection test vectors. Validates the SelectChannel procedure from spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md section 2a.3.1: (1) density > 8 returns CH0, (2) density <= 8 uses hash-based selection, and (3) CH0 is excluded from the modulo. Independent oracle: FNV-1a32(EUI64_BE || epoch_LE) with basis 0x811c9dc5, then 0 for plans without a data channel or 1 + (hash % (n_channels - 1)).

oracle.formula: IF density > 8 OR n_channels <= 1 THEN RETURN 0; data = eui64_be || epoch_le_u32; h = fnv1a32(data); RETURN 1 + (h % (n_channels - 1))

vectors.name: density_8_boundary_no_fallback
vectors.description: Density exactly 8 does NOT trigger CH0 fallback. This is the boundary case: density <= 8 uses hash-based selection.

vectors.name: density_9_triggers_ch0_fallback
vectors.description: Density 9 (just above threshold) triggers CH0 fallback. Per spec: IF Density > 8 THEN RETURN 0.

vectors.name: channel_changes_with_epoch
vectors.description: Channel selection is deterministic but varies with epoch. Same EUI64, different epoch -> different channel.

vectors.name: channel_consistency_same_inputs
vectors.description: Same inputs always produce same channel (deterministic). Verifies no random component.

vectors.name: epoch_wrap_u32_max
vectors.description: Epoch at u32 max value handles wrap correctly. Channel selection remains valid.

vectors.name: different_eui64_different_channel
vectors.description: Different EUI64 with same epoch/density produces different channel distribution.

vectors.name: n_channels_16_wider_distribution
vectors.description: With 16 total channels, output range is [1, 16). Same hash, different modulo.

vectors.name: control_only_plan_fails_closed
vectors.description: n_channels=1 contains only reserved CH0, so no data channel exists and selection fails closed to CH0.
